title: Owned UI and Tooling Stack
description: Phase 10 of the Interactivity-First Refactor. Replace third-party UI, graphics, text, browser boundary, clipboard, React product, Storybook, browser automation, build graph, cache, test runner, bundler, lint/format, docs and release dependencies with owned implementations behind existing contracts. Maintain direct platform host/graphics boundaries for Win32/Cocoa/Wayland/X11/browser and D3D12/Metal/Vulkan/WebGPU, differential fixtures throughout, cross-platform zero-touch operation, launch.json ordering, and a dependency audit/CI gate proving zero third-party packages under the declared runtime/build/test/tooling boundary.
